newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack firms as NatWest ups forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack firms as NatWest ups forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack climbed on Wednesday as analysts at NatWest Securities upgraded profit forecasts for the railway operator but maintained the stock as a "hold", market sources said.
The shares were up 16-1/2p at 337-1/2p by 1209 GMT in volume of over 5-1/2 million shares.
Analysts at NatWest upped their 1997 profit forecast to 305 million stg from 300 million stg, according to market sources.
Expectations for 1998 were raised to 340 million stg from 330 million stg and for 1999 to 380 million stg from 360 million stg.

Market sources said NatWest still rates the stock a "hold" but had raised forecasts due to good operating performance, excellent cost reduction -- ahead of expectations -- and a cash generative property portfolio.
